adjudication_summary: Source re-review recovered all locally supported activity-table values from XML Tables 1-4, reconciled the linked DBAASP rows to table or article metadata locators, and replaced the framework-test terminal state with a bounded accepted-with-cautions adjudication.

materials_exhausted.note: No supplementary files were present in the local source directory, OA package, extracted supplementary index, or archive manifest; this is nonblocking because XML Tables 1-4 carry the activity matrix.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay/experiment rows are matched to primary XML tables where activity values exist; endpoint-label mapping and no independent sequence field are retained as cautions rather than blockers.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Tables 1-4 were parsed into 14 row-level records with nested MIC/FIC/FICI/MIC50/Bliss values, units, target species/strain, conditions, and XML locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are bounded to source-located phenotype, membrane integrity, and efflux-checkerboard evidence; figure-only exact bar values are not invented.
per_layer_decision_rationale.final_adjudication: The original ticket is resolved by source-reviewed owner-layer repair; acceptance is with cautions, not clean acceptance.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP uses MBIC for anti-biofilm rows while the primary table column label is MIC in an anti-biofilm FICI assay; this was preserved rather than silently normalized.

The linked DBAASP rows provided peptide/compound identifiers and assay values but not a separate sequence field; source verification is bounded to compound name, citation, subject, assay context, and values present in the paper.
Local source/supplementary directory, OA package, supplementary_index.json, supplementary_tables.json, and archive manifest show no supplementary assets to extract.
Mechanism conclusions use source text, tables, and figure captions; no unsupported numeric values were inferred from figure images.
